The '''Engineer Capability Comparison''' places all 25 ship Engineers in one table. It is intended for comparing module coverage, referral dependencies, and initial workshop unlock requirements without repeating the full details from each Engineer's own article.

Engineers specialise in particular module families and may offer different maximum grades. Frontier introduced this system as a network of specialist workshops whose modifications require introductions, trust, and Engineering materials.<ref name="frontier-engineers">[https://community.elitedangerous.com/en/theengineersbetadate The Engineers Beta Release Date and Elite Dangerous 1.6], Frontier Developments, accessed 2026-09-15.</ref>

== How to use the comparison ==

* '''Specialities''' lists the module families each Engineer works on. Use the Engineer's own page for exact grade ceilings and blueprint-specific Live differences.
* '''Prerequisite Engineer''' shows direct referral relationships. A referral does not bypass the new Engineer's separate meeting or unlock conditions.
* '''Unlock requirement''' shows the final workshop payment, delivery, voucher hand-in, or other access task. Discovery and meeting requirements remain on the individual Engineer page.

The table is generated from the same canonical records used by the [[Engineers]] directory and individual Engineer infoboxes. Changes to those records therefore update this comparison without copying the values into article prose.

{{Important|Newer Live blueprint families can have their own Engineer lists and grade ceilings. Treat this as a module-family comparison; check the individual Engineer or blueprint article before travelling for a specific modification.}}

== Odyssey Engineers ==
Odyssey Engineers modify suits and handheld weapons rather than ship modules, and their modifications do not use the ship blueprint Grade 1–5 progression. They are therefore kept out of the ship-module table above. See [[Engineers#Odyssey Engineers|Odyssey Engineers]] and [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]] for the Live-only roster and modification directory.
